newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA STATEMENT ON RONALDO DELAYED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA STATEMENT ON RONALDO DELAYED.

text.p: FIFA is not expecting to release a statement as planned on Wednesday that would clarify its position on Brazilian striker Ronaldo's move from Barcelona to Internazionale following complications in the wording of the document.

With the confusion over who owns the world footballer of the year further complicated by a recent statement from the European Commission, warning world soccer's governing body that its transfer regulations may contravene European Union law, FIFA lawyers have required more time to go over the wording of the press release.
FIFA spokesman Keith Cooper said on Wednesday he expected the statement would now be released on Thursday.
